correctness.rationale: Finite geometric simplex fixed points are exactly unions of invariant vertex-orbit faces. Uniform d-cycle arc orbits are d-colored directed arcs between distinct orbit cycles; quotient directed cycles are equivalent to actual cycles. The resulting clone expansion of the shellable complete directed-forest complex is shellable by an explicit lifting of the shelling. The signed forest determinant det(I-d(kI-J))=(1-kd)^(k-1) gives the exact integer wedge rank. Sample enumerations and boundary ranks confirm boundary cases, without replacing the infinite proof.

value.rationale: All-parameter integral homotopy classification of a natural family of geometric symmetry-fixed spaces, reducing an exponentially large complex to a lower-dimensional shellable orbit model with an exact rapidly growing multiplicity. This supplies fixed-locus topology inaccessible from ordinary Betti counts or equivariant characters alone, and a structural phase-colored forest identification with future applications to other permutation types.
